_comment: Single source of truth for llm-llamacpp integration test models downloaded via ensureModel. Consumed by test/integration/utils.js for URL resolution + sha256 integrity, and by .github/actions/cache-models for the cache key. Populate sha256/bytes from a fresh clean download of each pinned URL. While a value is null, ensureModel logs a warning and skips verification. Keyed by the modelName passed to ensureModel (default small-test-model.gguf; an env override falls back to the passed downloadUrl with no integrity). Bump cacheEpoch to force a hard cache eviction.
